articles.title: Understanding a doc fee
articles.text: A doc fee is a dealer charge for paperwork. A sample doc fee is $100. This example is not a limit.

articles.title: Comparing outside financing offers
articles.text: Compare the amount financed and the loan term. A sample rate is 6%. Example Community Bank is a fictional lender.

articles.title: Documents to bring
articles.text: Bring your identification and outside financing offer. Keep a copy of the documents.
